SUMMARY - An ordinance to amend Clark County Code
Title 2, Chapter 2.70 - Clark County Office of Sports and
Special Events.
ORDINANCE NO. 5397
(of Clark County, Nevada)
AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND CLARK COUNTY CODE TITLE 2,
CHAPTER 2.70 - CLARK COUNTY OFFICE OF SPORTS AND
SPECIAL EVENTS, BY REMOVING “ FARMERS ’ MARKETS ”
AND “ HOLIDAY EVENTS ” FROM THE DEFINITION OF
“ SPECIAL EVENTS ” ; BY PROVIDING AN EXEMPTION FROM
CERTAIN SPECIAL EVENT REQUIREMENTS FOR COMMON ­
INTEREST COMMUNITIES; BY ELIMINATING SPECIAL
EVENT FEES; AND PROVIDING FOR OTHER MATTERS
PROPERLY RELATED THERETO.
THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF THE COUNTY OF CLARK,
STATE OF NEVADA, DOES HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
SECTION ONE. Title 2, Chapter 2.70, Section 2.70.010 of the Clark
County Code is hereby amended as follows:
2.70.010 D efinitions .
A. “ Activation ” means a distinct sub-event or activity occurring in
unincorporated Clark County that is part of one overarching special
event.
B. “Board ” means the Board of Clark County Commissioners.
C. “ Clark County Manager ” means the County Manager of the County of
Clark County or their designee.

ORDINANCE NO. 5397
AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND
CLARK COUNTY CODE TITLE 2,
CHAPTER 2.70 - CLARK
COUNTYOFFICE OF SPORTS AND
SPECIAL EVENTS. BY REMOVING
“ FARMERS ’ MARKETS ’ *
AND “ HOLIDAY EVENTS ” FROM
THE DEFINITION OF “ SPECIAL
EVENTS ” ; BY PROVIDING
AN EXEMPTION FROM CERTAIN
SPECIAL EVENT REQUIREMENTS
FOR COMMON ­
INTEREST COMMUNITIES; BY
ELIMINATING SPECIAL EVENT
FEES; AND PROVIDING FOR
OTHER MATTERS PROPERLY
RELATED THERETO.
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that
typewritten copies of the above
numbered and entitled
Ordinance are available for
inspection by all interested
parties at the Office of the
County Clerk of Clark County.
Nevada, at her Commission
Division Office on the first floor
of the Clark County
Government Center, 500 South
Grand Central Parkway, Las
Vegas, Nevada, and that said
Ordinance was proposed by
Commissioner Michael Nafton
the 16th day of June 2026 and
passed on the 7th day of July
2026, by the following vote of
the Board of County
Commissioners:
Aye:
Michael Naft
William McCurdy II
April Becker
James B. Gibson
Justin Jones
Marilyn K. Kirkpatrick
Tick Segerblom
Nay: None
Abstaining: None
Absent: None
This Ordinance shall be in full
force and effect on the 22nd
day of July 2026.
(SEAL) LYNN MARIE GOYA.
COUNTY CLERK
and Ex-Officio Clerk of the
Board of County
Commissioners
Dated this 7th day of July 2026
